When Bruce finds a golf buddy in supermodel Angie Everhart, Kris wonders if she should call up an old buddy of her own - especially when she spots some incriminating behavior that makes her think he's contemplating an affair.
Kris does the unthinkable when she goes behind Bruce's back and meets up with her ex Todd Waterman.

When the girls find out how serious their grandmother MJ's illness has gotten, they urge Kris to pay a visit. But the thought of seeing her mom brings up a lot of emotions for Kris, who tries to use her busy schedule as a way to dodge the trip to San Diego.
Scott's insecurities drive a wedge between him and Kourtney's family, driving him to ditch their exotic vacation.
